SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW t1 AS VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b') tbl(c1, c2)
SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW t2 AS VALUES (1.0, 1), (2.0, 4) tbl(c1, c2)
READ	SELECT udf(c1) as c1, udf(c2) as c2
READ	SELECT udf(c1) as c1, udf(c2) as c2
READ	SELECT udf(udf(a)) as a
SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW p1 AS VALUES 1 T(col)
SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW p2 AS VALUES 1 T(col)
SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW p3 AS VALUES 1 T(col)
READ	SELECT udf(1) AS x,
READ	SELECT map(1, 2), udf('str') as str
READ	SELECT array(1, 2), udf('str') as str
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS t1
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS t2
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS p1
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS p2
SESSION	DROP VIEW IF EXISTS p3
